# Separate Gloda extension identity from the bound property name

defineAttribute builds a database identity from extensionName + ":" + attributeName. Its documentation permits bindName to override the exposed property name and warns that binding names need to avoid collisions. A scoped naming recommendation is to keep persistence identity and public object property roles distinct; changing a display label does not justify changing either key. This is static source and test-code inspection. Complete Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

Scope: mailnews/db/gloda.
